summary: Senior VP of Information Technology with 14 years of experience leading IT operations in the financial services industry, overseeing infrastructure, vendor management, disaster recovery, and system migrations.

experience.title: Senior VP - Information Technology
responsibilities: Directed global IT operations for a high‑yield and distressed debt trading firm.
Coordinated NYC office relocation and full hardware refresh.
Migrated legacy VPN to Toronto‑based MPLS network.
Implemented NJ data center for high‑availability trading operations.
Reduced capital expenditure by $1.5M through VM environment deployment.
Led migration of PBX to VoIP and video conferencing.
Established disaster recovery plan with Stamford, CT as DR site.
Negotiated vendor contracts and managed Bloomberg terminal and FIX connections.

experience.title: Chief Information Officer
responsibilities: Oversaw technology strategy for fixed‑income and equity trading firm.
Managed 8 U.S. branch offices’ network and telecommunications infrastructure.
Implemented disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
Negotiated and deployed new order management system and migrated FIX connections.
Replaced legacy web security appliances with Cisco ASA and IronPort.
Upgraded network circuits to reduce latency.
Established change control processes for hardware and software rollouts.

experience.title: IT Support Manager
responsibilities: Coordinated market data software and hardware upgrades across branches.
Implemented PC hardware and OS upgrades firm‑wide.
Managed Microsoft Exchange upgrade and daily backups.
Set equipment standards and ordered PCs, servers, and peripherals.
Handled market data entitlements and FIX connections.
Participated in FINRA and internal audits.

projects.name: NYC Office Relocation & Hardware Refresh
projects.description: Led the relocation of the primary NYC office, including a complete hardware refresh for network and desktop equipment.

projects.name: VPN to MPLS Migration
projects.description: Migrated legacy site‑to‑site VPN network to a Toronto‑based MPLS network across six U.S. branch offices.

projects.name: NJ Data Center Implementation
projects.description: Implemented a new data center for high‑availability trading operations and migrated direct client wires to the facility.

projects.name: Virtualization Cost Reduction
projects.description: Deployed a VMware environment that reduced hardware, energy, and licensing costs, saving $1.5M in capital expenditure.

projects.name: Disaster Recovery Plan
projects.description: Designed and implemented a disaster recovery plan, designating Stamford, CT as the DR site for the NYC office.
